notes.title: Indie Characters Dimensions – Official Crossover Trailer Reveal!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646818/c693b8dd45e8a8958644a6c98309d84f92f8e93d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hi, indie fans![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to finally reveal one of the biggest surprises we’ve been working on for [b]Gunny Ascend[/b]: [/p][p]A massive [b]crossover with 30+ indie characters[/b] making their way into our chaotic roguelite adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, with the release of our [b]Official Crossover Reveal Trailer[/b], we’re confirming the [b]first 4 characters[/b] joining Gunny Ascend:[/p][list][*][p]🧑‍🚀 [b]Crewmate[/b] ([i]Among Us[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]🥛 [b]Francis the Milkman[/b] ([i]That’s Not My Neighbor[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]🟩 [b]Edge[/b] ([i]Planet Cube: Edge[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]💎 [b]Amy[/b] [i](Wind and Water: Puzzle Battles)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning, these are the first 4 out of more than 30 indie legends that will be playable in the final game. Each one will bring [b]unique abilities set and personality[/b] into the chaos of Gunny Ascend, while also honoring the original spirit of the games they come from.[/p][p]If you haven’t yet, you can still: 🎮 [b]Play the free demo on Steam right now[/b] – experience 4 chaotic levels and face off against the boss Miasmo. 📌 [b]Add Gunny Ascend to your Wishlist[/b] – so you don’t miss future reveals and updates.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Watch the Official Trailer here! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gsSUFU7tywY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This is just the beginning of our indie multiverse and we can’t wait to show you who’s coming next. 👀[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned. The crossover has just begun.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Sunna Entertainment Team[/p]

notes.title: The Final Countdown Begins – Free Demo August 18th!
notes.notes: [p]Hi Chaotics! 💣✨[/p][p]We’ve got BIG news, the [i]Gunny Ascend[/i] public demo is dropping [b]August 18th[/b], and it’s 100% free for everyone on Steam![/p][p]This isn’t just any demo… you’ll get to challenge [b]MIASMO[/b], the chaotic final boss that will control the miasma against you. He’s fast, unpredictable, and will flood the arena with danger at every turn. Beat him, and you’ll prove you’ve got what it takes for the chaos ahead.[/p][p][b]What’s in the demo?[/b][/p][list][*][p]4 intense levels with roguelite twists 🧩[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of abilities to mix and match ⚡[/p][/*][*][p]The epic Miasmo boss fight 🔥[/p][/*][*][p]Full replayability – no two runs are the same🕹️[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Add [i]Gunny Ascend[/i] to your wishlist so you don’t miss the release, and get ready to show us your best plays![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646818/225c037fefa23094cc972d3824f90998d54e47c5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Help Us Shape the Chaos! Join the Closed Demo Beta
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646818/276809fbdc8f1738b28e9d02404fe9e3d0f2996d.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What’s the Closed Demo Beta?[/b][/h2][p]This isn’t the final demo.[/p][p]It’s a [b]special early build[/b] we’re opening to players who want to:[/p][p]✅ Try the game before anyone else ✅ Help shape the final experience ✅ Share feedback that directly influences development[/p][p]We’re calling it a [b]Close Demo Beta Weekend[/b], and you’re invited to play![/p][h2][b]How to Join?[/b][/h2][p]All you need to do is fill out this short form or scan this QR code:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646818/15ff4b60b053212b0076a2d4d2a68994bc8137cc.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScwWMWFjxId7TXOa4v1phyMZuHadgMpV0xFqfmYrksmnIqLDw/viewform" style="button"]Click here for the Form[/url][/p][p]We’ll email your Steam key before the event starts, on the 24th of July.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Haven’t Seen the Trailer?[/b][/h2][p]Watch the official announcement trailer now:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/w7Lozrf0s5Q"][/dynamiclink]Get a [b]sneak peek[/b] at the chaos waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thanks for Supporting Indie Devs![/b][/h2][p]This is a big step for our team at [b]Sunna Entertainment[/b], and we’re so excited to bring you into the world of Gunny Ascend.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you July 25-27![/b][/p][p] -  [i]The Sunna Team[/i][/p][p][/p]
